			SELECT
			  product.id,
				product.name,
				product.brief,
				product.slug,
				product.amount,
				product.quantity,
				product.has_variants,
				product.active,
				product.digital,
				(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_data WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id AND digital_data.cart_id IS NULL) OR
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_file WHERE digital_file.product_id = product.id)) AS digital_filled,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', pi.id, 'name', pi.name, 'ext', pi.ext, 'position', pi.position, 'is_representative', CASE WHEN pi.is_representative = 1 THEN json('true') ELSE json('false') END)) FROM (SELECT * FROM product_image WHERE product_id = product.id ORDER BY position, id) pi) as image,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', product_variant.id, 'sku', product_variant.sku, 'quantity', product_variant.quantity, 'price_surcharge', product_variant.price_surcharge, 'option_values', json(product_variant.option_values), 'active', CASE WHEN product_variant.active = 1 THEN json('true') ELSE json('false') END)) FROM product_variant WHERE product_id = product.id) as variants,
				strftime('%s', created)
			FROM product
		 WHERE product.deleted = FALSE  ORDER BY product.created DESC, product.id

			SELECT
			  product.id,
				product.name,
				product.brief,
				product.slug,
				product.amount,
				product.quantity,
				product.has_variants,
				product.active,
				product.digital,
				(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_data WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id AND digital_data.cart_id IS NULL) OR
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_file WHERE digital_file.product_id = product.id)) AS digital_filled,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', pi.id, 'name', pi.name, 'ext', pi.ext, 'position', pi.position, 'is_representative', CASE WHEN pi.is_representative = 1 THEN json('true') ELSE json('false') END)) FROM (SELECT * FROM product_image WHERE product_id = product.id ORDER BY position, id) pi) as image,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', product_variant.id, 'sku', product_variant.sku, 'quantity', product_variant.quantity, 'price_surcharge', product_variant.price_surcharge, 'option_values', json(product_variant.option_values), 'active', CASE WHEN product_variant.active = 1 THEN json('true') ELSE json('false') END)) FROM product_variant WHERE product_id = product.id AND active = TRUE) as variants,
				strftime('%s', created)
			FROM product
		
			WHERE product.deleted = FALSE AND (
				product.active = TRUE
				OR EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM digital_data
					WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id
					AND digital_data.cart_id = ?
				)
			)
		 ORDER BY product.created DESC, product.id LIMIT ?
---
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product.id) FROM product
			WHERE product.deleted = FALSE AND (
				product.active = TRUE
				OR EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM digital_data
					WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id
					AND digital_data.cart_id = ?
				)
			)

			SELECT
				product.id,
				product.name,
				product.brief,
				product."desc",
				product.slug,
				product.amount,
				product.quantity,
				product.sku,
				product.has_variants,
				product.active,
				product.metadata,
				product.attribute,
				product.digital,
				product.seo,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', pi.id, 'name', pi.name, 'ext', pi.ext, 'position', pi.position, 'is_representative', CASE WHEN pi.is_representative = 1 THEN json('true') ELSE json('false') END)) FROM (SELECT * FROM product_image WHERE product_id = product.id ORDER BY position, id) pi) as images,
				strftime('%s', product.created),
				strftime('%s', product.updated)
	, (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_data WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id AND digital_data.cart_id IS NULL) OR
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_file WHERE digital_file.product_id = product.id)) AS digital_filled
			FROM product
			WHERE product.id = ?

			SELECT 
					p.digital,
					df.id, df.name, df.ext,
					dd.id, dd.content, dd.cart_id
			FROM product p
			LEFT JOIN digital_file df ON p.id = df.product_id
			LEFT JOIN digital_data dd ON p.id = dd.product_id
			WHERE p.id = ?

SELECT COUNT(*)
	FROM (
		SELECT email FROM customer
		UNION
		SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email FROM cart WHERE TRIM(email) <> '' AND payment_status = ?
	) e
	LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.email = e.email
	 WHERE (e.email LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(COALESCE(c.name, '')) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')
---

	SELECT
		c.id AS account_id,
		e.email,
		COALESCE(c.name, '') AS name,
		c.active,
		strftime('%s', c.created) AS created,
		strftime('%s', c.updated) AS updated,
		COALESCE(o.purchases, 0) AS purchases,
		COALESCE(o.spent, 0) AS spent,
		COALESCE(o.last_order, 0) AS last_order
	
	FROM (
		SELECT email FROM customer
		UNION
		SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email FROM cart WHERE TRIM(email) <> '' AND payment_status = ?
	) e
	LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.email = e.email
	
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT
			LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email,
			COUNT(*) AS purchases,
			SUM(CASE WHEN currency = ? THEN amount_total ELSE 0 END) AS spent,
			MAX(strftime('%s', created)) AS last_order
		FROM cart
		WHERE payment_status = ? AND TRIM(email) <> ''
		GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(email))
	) o ON o.email = e.email
	 WHERE (e.email LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(COALESCE(c.name, '')) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')
	ORDER BY (o.last_order IS NULL), o.last_order DESC, e.email
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
---
SELECT COUNT(*)
	FROM (
		SELECT email FROM customer
		UNION
		SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email FROM cart WHERE TRIM(email) <> '' AND payment_status = ?
	) e
	LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.email = e.email
	 WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL
---

	SELECT
		c.id AS account_id,
		e.email,
		COALESCE(c.name, '') AS name,
		c.active,
		strftime('%s', c.created) AS created,
		strftime('%s', c.updated) AS updated,
		COALESCE(o.purchases, 0) AS purchases,
		COALESCE(o.spent, 0) AS spent,
		COALESCE(o.last_order, 0) AS last_order
	
	FROM (
		SELECT email FROM customer
		UNION
		SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email FROM cart WHERE TRIM(email) <> '' AND payment_status = ?
	) e
	LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.email = e.email
	
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT
			LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email,
			COUNT(*) AS purchases,
			SUM(CASE WHEN currency = ? THEN amount_total ELSE 0 END) AS spent,
			MAX(strftime('%s', created)) AS last_order
		FROM cart
		WHERE payment_status = ? AND TRIM(email) <> ''
		GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(email))
	) o ON o.email = e.email
	 WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL
	ORDER BY (o.last_order IS NULL), o.last_order DESC, e.email
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
